programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: A German village is shocked when a body is found mutilated beyond recognition; when archaeologists investigate further, they find evidence of human sacrifice.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: In Russia, 34,000-year-old graves are discovered; a team attempts to locate a World War II British airplane that went missing in Iceland; tiny fossils in an Alaskan riverbank; a massive, previously undiscovered depression in the ice in Antarctica.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: With more than 300 UFO sightings each year, the townspeople living within the Falkirk Triangle can't help but feel uneasy about the strange occurrences. From reports of abduction, missing persons, lost time and physical attack, to unexplained interference on airport radar. What evidence exists that the first sighting took place as early as 1767? And why has the local provost continued to lobby three prime ministers to investigate to no avail?

programs.title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
programs.desc: A powerful military leader unites the lands we know as Egypt and assumes the title of Pharaoh; exploring how he maintains this position of power; what tools does he use to build a system that will last 3,000 years?

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: What happens when humanity does not prepare for the worst that Mother Nature can unleash, and how people can better prepare for the disasters of the future.

programs.title: Digital Tsunami: Big Tech, Big AI, Big Brother
programs.desc: This documentary will examine how toxic elements of digital environment are dramatically transforming society in negative ways, just as the prophetic, popular futurist Marshall McLuhan predicted 60 years ago. Examining the unforeseen social and political problems caused by the digital revolution, and highlight the need for laws and regulations to protect citizens, especially the most vulnerable.
